id./param/scenario/cs/b_110_cs_020.pack|cs_: "What is this feeling... Why is my chest so restless...
"After such a catastrophe, Sniflheim Castle can't have escaped unscathed.
"I want to confirm Queen Frysabel's safety. {var:1}, before heading to Arboria, let's enter Sniflheim Castle.
"The rest of you, please check on the castle town.
"...No, I'm fine. I just look around town, right?
"...No, don't strain yourself. Without memory, going alone must feel lonely. Come with us.
"Ho ho, not like you. Don't mind. ...Now, {var:1}, let's go to the castle and see Frysabel."
